text:
Low carbohydrate intake reduces the body's available glycogen stores, which can significantly impair physical performance during high-intensity or prolonged endurance exercise. While this dietary approach may offer benefits for weight management and blood sugar control in certain contexts, it is not universally advantageous without considering an individual's activity level and health status. Therefore, athletes engaging in rigorous training should be cautious of potential deficits in energy availability when restricting carbohydrates.
